replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
vsplesk did the screenshots and video. He also introduced the idea of the stained glasses. He made it look like a freakin beautiful mural.

He also made the ponds.

I did the YML, the spawn loadout and the spawn. Me and vsplesk did the trees. I created the iron supply. I also came up with the unique idea of diagonal based gameplay :)

At first this map was just me and vsplesk. But then we asked Hoops if he wanted to help. And he did, a lot. He didn't really come up with ideas but he created some beautiful stained glass patterns and he helped a lot.

So yeah! This map had heavy teamwork. We accepted each other's ideas and made sure they didn't interfere with gameplay. Thank you to all who commented. 

If you want to join our build team that sparked from this map then please refer to the OP. 

Thank you :)
